ajaia: Ajaia is a genus of Platalea.

ajaia ajaja: Ajaia ajaja is tropical rose-colored New World spoonbill.

ajax: Ajax is a mythical Greek hero.
ajuga: Ajuga means the same as genus Ajuga.
ajuga chamaepitys: Ajuga chamaepitys is low-growing annual with yellow flowers dotted red.

ajuga genevensis: Ajuga genevensis is upright rhizomatous perennial with bright blue flowers.

ajuga pyramidalis: Ajuga pyramidalis is European evergreen carpeting perennial.
Ajuga pyramidalis means the same as pyramid bugle.
ajuga reptans: Ajuga reptans is low rhizomatous European carpeting plant having spikes of blue flowers.
Ajuga reptans means the same as creeping bugle.
